item.description:
Your task order, kept in Notion.
- **Task order lives in Notion.** Map a number column on your Tasks table in Settings › Fields, or click Create Column, and the order you drag tasks into is saved on the tasks themselves. It's the same on every device, and in any Notion view sorted by that column. Your current arrangement is copied over on the next sync.
Fixes
- Edits that hit Notion's rate limit are now retried instead of being undone.

Settings that follow you, and task durations you can tune.
- **Settings sync across your Macs.** Durations, bucket limits, colors, block titles, Notion field mapping, scheduling and calendar display preferences now sync through iCloud. Calendar choices stay per Mac. - **Default task duration.** Pick 15 minutes to 1½ hours in Settings › Planning. New blocks use it unless the project sets its own. - **Per-project durations in Notion.** Map a number column on your Projects table in Settings › Fields, or click Create Column, and each project's default duration lives in Notion. - **Smarter bucket sizing.** Buckets size themselves from their open sub-tasks, capped at a multiple of the project default you choose. - **New tasks appear instantly.** Press Return and the task slides into the list right away, without waiting for Notion.
Fixes
- Booking a task on a later day no longer moves it into Today.

Share your availability by email.
- **Scheduling.** Turn on the calendar-clock button in the toolbar, then drag across the calendar to mark when you're free. Drag again to add more times, on any day; click a marked time to unmark it. - **Copy a snippet.** Copy puts your free times on the clipboard as plain text, grouped by day and ready to paste into an email. Times next to each other show as one range, like 9:00 – 10:00 AM. - **Pick the meeting length.** Choose 15 minutes to 1½ hours. The snippet names it, and leaves out marked times too short to fit it. - **Show other time zones.** Tick Time zones and add any you like. Each time then appears in every zone, with the weekday added where it falls on a different day.
